(tha)༄༅/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bsod nams rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa'i

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bsod nams rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/ sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la// btud nas bskal mang tshogs chen po// myur du 'dums byed cho ga bri// 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed par 'dod pas/ kye rdo rje las/ gang du zos pas 'dod don kun// sgrub pa can gyis dngos grub 'gyur// dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang*// de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang*// yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar// bza' ba 'di ni rab tu za// zhes dang*/ a bha yā ka ras/ nye bar 'tshe med dur khrod dgon// rdzing bu'i 'gram dang skyed mos 'tshal// mtsho ngogs chu klung ri sul dang*// rang gi khyim sogs 'bras bur bcas// zhes pas gsang sngags la ma dad pa'i skye bos dben pa'i gnas su bya'o// dus gang du bya ba ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na k+ṣi tas/ rnal 'byor kun spyod la sogs pa'i// 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyis ni// nag po'i phyogs dang dkar phyogs kyi// bcu pa la ni de rab mchod// yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang*// de bzhin du ni brgyad pa la// dpal ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje mchod// dus kyi 'khor lo nya gnyis la// gsang ba 'dus pa zla re bzhin// lnga brgyad bcu dang bcu bzhi dang*// de bzhin bco lnga nag phyogs la'ang*// lnga ste dus ni bcu ru 'gyur// de dag dus kyi khyad par ro// 'dir ni rtag tu phun tshogs sam// ji ltar 'dod cing ji ltar nus// grub par nus na nyin re'am// lo zla kun tu bya ba'o// zhes dang*/ a bha yā ka ras/ sngags pas khyad par mtshan mo'i dus// zhag re'am ni ji snyed par// zla re dang ni lo re la// 'khor lo las 'das nyams par 'gyur// zhes pas lo re la ma mtha' re re ma byas na dam tshig nyams par gsungs/ de la'ang mtshan dus lhag par bsngags pa ni/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// rtag tu mtshan mo 'phyan pa dang*// rtag tu mtshan mo 'du bar byed// mkha' spyod shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i// dngos grub chen po ster bar 'gyur// zhes so// gang gis bya ba'i 'du ba po gang zag ni/ ḍom+bhi pas/ de nas gzhan yang dam tshig ldan// bla ma la gus rtog pa chung*// 'khon gcugs med cing rang dad pa'i// lha grangs mi la gsol ba gdab// ces dang*/ a bha yā ka ras/ dpal ldan chog shes snying rje ldan// 'jig rten chos la mi chags shing*// sred dang sgyu sogs rnam par spangs// snyan par smra zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin// bzod can brtan la brtson 'grus ldan// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpas gsungs// 'khor lo pa yang de nyid kyi// slob ma sred sogs rnam par spangs// dbang bskur thob cing blo ldan bzod// brtson dang dran pa la sogs ldan// dam tshig spyad bya spyod pa rnams// rgan pa'i rim pa bzhin du 'dod// dbang ma thob pas mi rig par// sgrub pos 'khor lo de bya'o// zhes so// de la rdo rje slob dpon ni/ sdom 'byung las/ sbyin bdag dad pa chen po yis// khyim gnas yang na dge tshul lam// slob dpon dge slong nyid kyang ste// kha cig 'jig rten na bstan la// gnas pa dge slong slob dpon no// kha cig 'jig rten yon tan 'phags// mngon shes thob pa nyid kyang ste// 'di rnams nang na gtso bo mchog /sbyin bdag dad pa kha cig go /zhes pas dge slong*/ dge tshul/ dge bsnyen gsum rab 'bring tha ma dang*/ dge slong yod bzhin du khyim pas slob dpon bya mi rung ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'phags pa'i sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa yin kyang tshogs kyi gtso bo mchog yin no// las kyi rdo rje ni/ sdom 'byung las/ gtsang zhing dul la dpa' bo'i sems// sred dang gti mug rnam par spangs// thams cad mtshungs par blta ba ni// las kyi rdo rjer rab tu brtag

/ces pas phyogs lhung dang bral ba dgos so// rat+na rak+ṣi tas/ gang zhig 'di rnams thams cad la// dpa' bo rkyang pa'i bya ba ni// dpa' bo'i ston mo zhes su brjod// tshogs kyi dbang phyug de lta min// de bzhin dpa' mo rkyang pa la// dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ston mo nyid// de ltar 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la// shes rab thabs dang bcas pa nyid// ces pas dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis ka tshogs pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lor bshad do// tshogs 'khor byed pa'i dgos pa ni/ grub chen sha ba ri pas/ tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa dang*// rnal 'byor dam tshig gso ba dang*// bde gshegs mkha' 'gro mchod bya'i phyir// dpa' bo'i ston mo tshogs 'khor bshad// ces dang*/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas/ dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon sel cing*// mi mthun phyogs rnams 'joms byed pa// 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa nyid// lhag pa'i lha yang tshim par 'gyur// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni// myur du lung bstan 'thob par byed// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yi// rim 'dis 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin// zhes dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa 'di yis ni// ji ltar rigs par 'bad gyur na// de yi bsod nams mtha' ma ni// tshad bzung nus pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ gur las/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos dang*// ri dang ral gri gzugs nyid dang*// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// sbyin sreg cho gas mgu gyur te// de bzhin tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro// zhes pas sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor los 'phags pa dang 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad tshim par gsungs pa dang*/ snying po rgyan las/ sdig pa thams cad rnam dag cing*// rgya chen 'bras la nyer sbyor ba// zhes dang*/ rje gar dbang gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs mchod las/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yar mar gyi tshes bcu la sogs pa dus bzang po dang bstun nas tshul bzhin du bskor bas phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/

gnas yul na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams byon te/ rang gi rtsa gnas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba/ rdo rje'i sku mngon du gyur pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pas tshul 'dir 'bad par bya'o// zhes so// tshogs kyi rdzas ni/ ḍom+bhi pas/ mgron rnams dga' bar bya ba'i phyir// de la sha dang chang dag dang*// 'bras chan la du 'khur ba dang*// de bzhin bza' dang bca' ba dang*// btung dang de bzhin bldag dang myang*// 'jig rten pa yi 'byor pa yis// tshogs ni 'byor tshad sta gon bya// de bzhin spos dang byug pa dang*// dri dang me tog phreng mchog dang*// mar me bdug pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje lha mo myos byed sha rnams kyis// skye bo gus pas de rnams mchod byas na// he ru ka dpal mngon dgar gyur pa yis// gang phyir de rnams lag na mchog gi gnas// mgu ba'i sems kyis mchog ni stsol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ gtor ma myos byed med par las// myur du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro// des na sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis// gtor ma rab tu bsngags pa gsungs// zhes pa rnams/ snying po rgyan las/ shing dang nya lcibs dag dang ni// na ra ka la sa yi snod// mi yi thod pa dag bsham mo// thun mong snod ni thod pa ste// yang na thams cad la yang shing*// zhes pas snod de rnams su za 'dod kyi bsam pas rgyas par bzhag pa dang*/ ser snas bcing ba sogs ma yin par gtsang zhing gya nom par mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham mo// tshogs kyi skabs su kun spyod ni/ snying po rgyan las/ bla mas rjes su gnang min par// glu dang gar sogs mi bya'o// ji ltar mchod dang longs spyod pa// tshim pa ru ni ma byas par// bre mo'i gtam dang 'du 'dzi'i sems// rnam pa kun tu mi bya ste// byas na dmyal sogs 'bras thob 'gyur// mchod tshe gshung na ngu 'bod de// sred pas yi dwags nges par 'gyur// rang gi bsam gtan bral gyur na// dud 'gro'i gnas su ltung phyir dang*// sems dpa' rab tu brtan pa yis// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang*// sa gsum pa ni rab tu mchod// ji srid gtor ma ma btang bar// 'khor lo'i phyi rol 'gro mi bya// gang du dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// tshim pa ru ni mi nus na// de dag snyan gsan dbab mi bya// gang du tshim par ma gyur pa// de ni bsod nams rab zad byed// de bas kun tu rnal 'byor pa// zas sogs kyis ni tshim par bya// zhes so// bza' btung 'dren pa la ha cang gang ba dang*/

de bzhes nas yang bskyar len pa la snod stong pa min pa bya ste/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas/ 'dren pa ha cang gang ba min// len pa ha cang stong pa min// zhes dang*/ yang yang ldang dang 'dug pa dang*// mgrin pa bsgyur sogs rtag tu spang*// zhes dang*/ dam tshig lnga pa las/ snod ni sa la bzhag pa'am// gzhan la byin par gyur pa na// lag nas bo na chad pas bcad// rang gis thams cad mi btung ngo*// bza' dang btung ba rang gis ni// shin tu ltogs kyang blang mi bya// rtsod pa la sogs gang byed pa// de nas de ni gdon par bya// yang na gdon par mi nus na// de tshe sdig pa la brtags pas// rang nyid gzhan du 'gro ba'am// mi smra ba la brten par bya// las kyi rdo rje btung sogs la// rang gis blangs kyang nyes pa med// spyod lam shugs kyis phyir 'gro na// de ni dgag par mi bya'o// mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhe sdang gis// gzhan smod dam pa ma yin pa'i// tshig gis smad kyang rtsod pa'i gtam// mi dga' ba yang spang bar bya// bkag pa yang ni spyod gyur na// rtsa ba'i ltung dang sbom po ni// myur du gso ba'i cho ga bya// de ni ldang ba'i cho gar grags// rdo rje slob dpon tshim gyur pas// bar du gtor ma sbyin par bya// glu dang gar la sogs rgyun ni// de yi bka' yis gnang bar bya// tshogs kyis 'dus pa la bya ba// lag pa rkang sogs bag ldan bya// shin tu bag med rgyu yi phyir// btung ba mang po spyad mi bya// mang dag gis ni g.yeng bar 'gyur// g.yeng bas rnal 'byor 'khrugs 'gyur zhing*// rnal 'byor nyams pas dngos grub med// bdud kyi las ni bzlog par dka'// gang yang sems ni srung nus pas// rang ngam gzhan la mchod par bya// gzugs sogs sna tshogs dag pa yis// de yis 'di ni dngos grub 'gyur// skad cig tsam yang gzhan gzugs kyis// mi rig gdug can gyi ni sems// grub 'dod dngos grub don gnyer ba'i// 'bad pas mkhas pas gnas mi bya// zhes pas rnal 'byor pho mo gnyis ka tshogs na bdud rtsi sngon du dpa' mo dang*/

de rjes dpa' bo/ sha sngon du dpa' bo dang*/ de rjes dpa' mos len/ dgos dbang gis 'gro dgos byung na tshogs kyi gtso bo la gnang ba gsol te 'gro 'ong thams cad la gtso bo la phyag bya/ snod stong par mi bzhag zas sa rjen sa la mi bzhag las kyi rdo rjes ma byin par bza' btung rang gis mi blang*/ sha dang bdud rtsi sogs la mi gtsang ba dang the tshom gyi bsam pas longs mi spyad/ chang sems g.yeng bar 'gyur bas khyim pa yin yang bag med du mi 'thung*/ theg dman gyi bsam pa spang*/ gzugs sgra sogs la dag pa'i snang zhen dang ma bral bar bya/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i skad kyis mi smra na// de yi dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// zhes pas rin chen 'bar ba las/ gang gis sor mo gcig ston pa// 'ongs sam zhes ni 'dri ba yin// gnyis ni legs par 'ong ba yin// mthe bong g.yon pa bcang ba ni// bde ba'i phyag rgyar shes par bya// ma da na chang ba la sha /zan ni tri pi tri ka ra// tshod ma ma la ti daṃ naṃ// zhes pas sha la ba la dang*/ chang la ma da na zhes sogs brjod/ rje gar dbang gis/ 'di dag gi tshe sbyong lam yang 'di ltar bya dgos te/ de yang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa ḍa ma ru rdor dril sogs lus la bcang*/ khyad par tshogs byin gyis brlabs pa nas mjug tu dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba ma zin bar lag pa rdor dril dang*/ ngag brda tshig yid lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya zhing*/ long gtam sogs spang la spyod lam dal ba'i sgo nas ngag snyan par rdo rje'i glu gar dang*/ chos kyi gtam la sogs pa 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar bya'o// gad mo'i sgra chen po dang ku co sogs spang*/ khyad par tshogs la rtsod pa dang*/ ngag gi tshig ngan/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur ngan pa/ yid kyi khro ba sogs nges par spang bar bya zhing*/ ming tha mal pa mi brjod par gsang mtshan nam rnal 'byor pa zhes brjod/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dam tshig mi gcig pa dang*/

gsang sngags la mi mos pa/ bla ma la mi dad pa sogs la gtan nas mi sbyin/ gal te dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bus phyi dro kha zas spong sems kyi bsam pas tshogs rdzas khyad du bsad na rtsa ltung du 'gyur la/ yang bza' btung la longs spyod 'dod kyi bsam pas tshogs 'khor byas na ngan song mi zad pa'i gnas su ltung ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ 'di ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dgos pa 'bras bu mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ches myur du thob pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sku dang bde stong gi ye shes gnyis dbyer med pas thabs shes dbyer med yin la/ de lta bu'i bde ba yang byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bde ba yin cing*/ bde ba de skyed par byed pa la 'dod pa'i yul la longs spyod pa las byung ba'i nyon mongs lam du lhongs pa zhig dgos la/ des na skabs 'dir yang bza' btung la longs spyod pas dbang po rten byed kyi lus bskyed pa nas bzung*/ bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can skyed par byed pa'i tshul sogs rgyud dang grub chen gyi man ngag rnams las rtogs par bya ste/ stong nyid kyi rtsis zin pa dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan por bya dgos shing*/ de lta ma yin par khyim pa tha mal pa dag dga' ston du tshogs pa ltar bag yangs su song na dam tshig nyams pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams khros te dngos grub mi 'grub cing*/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sogs kyi nyen shin tu che bas gong du bshad pa ltar gyi spyod lam sogs kyis mtshon tshul dang ldan par bya ba gnad shin tu che'o// zhes so// de ltar rnam gzhag dang go don nges par byas nas ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la rgyas pa mtshan nyid pa dang*/ bsdus pa rjes mthun pa gnyis kyi dang po'i phyag len phra rags ngor chen rdo rje 'chang sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga las rtogs par bya zhing*/ phyi ma'i dbang du byas te bkod pa 'di ltar sor bzhag tu bri ba ni//

༈ /rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde spyi dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod bya tshul nyung ngu gsal sgron zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/ bla ma mchog dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rtse gcig sems kyis gus pas phyag byas te// tshogs kyi mchod pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// snying po mdor bsdus ngag gis 'dir bshad bya// de yang rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod byed pa'i skabs dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i dus su med du mi rung ba'i tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ sgrub mchod kyi dus dkyil 'khor gyi mdun dang sbyin sreg gi tshe mchod pa'i mdun du tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa dang*/ khyad par thod pa'i snod du sha chang sogs bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sgrub mchod yin na dbang chog btang tshar ba'i rjes su bya/ sbyin sreg gi dus yin na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i rjes su tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la/ las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon gyi ka pā la'i nang gi bdud rtsi bran/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad byin rlabs mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis cho ga gang dang 'brel ba de'i nang mchod byin rlabs skabs ltar rgyas par bya/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes tshogs phud bcad nas snod gcig tu blugs pa dang*/ ma da na snod gcig tu blugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul/ slob dpon kyis ka pā la'i bdud rtsi bran nas dpon slob thams cad kyis 'di skad gyer ro// hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsir rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas sgo gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/

pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsir rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥmaṇ+ḍa la de wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsir rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di// dkon mchog rin chen tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas srid zhi'i 'jigs las bsgral du gsol// oṃ āḥtri rat+na sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsir rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di// mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas rnal 'byor phrin las sgrub tu gsol// oṃ āḥḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsir rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di// mar gyur rigs drug tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas 'khrul snang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /oṃ āḥṣa ḍa ku la ga ti ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ thod pa dum gcig pa chang gis bkang ste/ lag pa gnyis pad+ma'i gar skor sngon du 'gro bas lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga bkram pa'i steng du ka pā la'i dpral ba pha rol la bstan pa bzhag lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan pa lhag ma gsum brkyangs pa ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas sha cung zad gzung ste thod pa'i steng nas bkab pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshul du byas pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste des bzung la/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshogs kyi khyad par 'di// dad pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes brjod/

dpon slob rnams kyis/ e ma ye shes chen po rnams// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs sreg /'di 'dra'i bde ba thob nas ni// kun gyi a ho su kha brjod// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ yang las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal la pad kor phyag rgya sngar bzhin bzung la/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// dman pa'i sgom pa dor bar gyis// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a la la hoḥ zhes pas drang*/ dpon slob rnams kyis kyang phyag rgya de nyid bstan la/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a la la hoḥzhes brjod la blangs nas bza' btung sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bsreg rdzas su mos nas nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyad nas tshim par rol/ 'di dag gi skabs su sha la ba la dang chang la ma da na la sogs pa'i brda skad bya/ bza' btung las kyi rdo rjes drangs pa ma gtogs rang gis blangs nas mi bza'/ tshogs rdzas sa rjen la mi 'jog thams cad kyis dga' ba'i gtam dang chos kyi glu sogs ma gtogs kha shag dang ngan smras cung zad kyang bya mi rung ngo*// de nas las kyi rdo rjes tshogs lhag thams cad bsdus mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar dang bcas slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du bzhag chu gtsang dang*/ slob dpon gyis chang gi zhal phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas gtor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad brjod do// hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsir rab 'khyil tshogs lhag 'di// dam can zhing skyong tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs// oṃ āḥk+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/

pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes phyi rol du dor/ ḍa dril rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing*/ de nas dkyil 'khor sgos kyi cho ga sogs rang gi gzhung bzhin kyus la 'jug par bya'o// tshul 'di ni chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor bde chen rnam rol dang*/ de'i lag len bya tshul rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i dpa' bo'i dga' ston gyi cho ga 'khrul med lam bzang gnyis kyi dgongs don gzhir bzung*/ kha skong 'os pa'i rigs rmor chen rdo rje 'chang dang*/ rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung gis kha bskangs/ rje bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi phyag len chu 'bab mas zur nas brgyan/ don la rang bzo'i lhad ma zhugs par byas te las dang po pa rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir du ngag 'don tsam zhig gtso bor bkod pa yin la 'di dag gi go don dang mtha' dpyod lag len rgyas par gong ma'i yi ge rnams las rtogs par bya'o// de ltar dngos grub ma lus 'gugs pa dang*// dam tshig nyams chags mtha' dag gso ba'i phyir// tshogs kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul// brgyud ldan bla ma'i bzhed srol ji bzhin bkod// rig 'dzin sngags sdom thob la ma nyams zhing*// las 'bras 'dor len spyod pa'i ngang tshul can// mkhyen ldan rnams kyis 'di bzhin mdzad gyur na// kho bo dad pa'i spu longs cis mi g.yo// sngags sgor zhugs kyang dam tshig mi srung ba'i// ser gzugs chang nag don gnyer can rnams kyis// 'di 'dra'i lag len 'khyar 'khyor byas gyur kyang*// don med gsang sgrogs nyes pa bsgrubs par zad// rnyed dka'i rin chen mi lus thob pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bka' dang mjal ba da lan tsam// grogs dag byis pa'i phal spyod da bzhag nas// dam tshig sdom pa bsrungs na mi mdzes sam// tshul 'di bskrun las thob pa'i dge tshogs ni// dung dang zla 'od kun+da ltar dkar ba// gang des sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i chos// gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig

/ces bla med rgyud sde spyi dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod bya tshul nyung ngu gsal sgron zhes bya ba 'di ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug ri phug slob dpon chos rje skal bzang don grub kyis dgos tshul phebs pa dang*/ lhag par nye ba'i char rab rgyas slob dpon rin chen dpal ldan gyis yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa shākya'i dge sbyong blo gsal bstan skyong gis kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba'i lo chu shel gyi dbang po sag sa nya ba'i dkar cha 'phel ba'i dga' ba dang po'i nyin/ nyang smad zhwa lu ri phug gi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig 'di'i lung rje bla ma nyid kyi zhal snga nas bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la'o// ༈ /tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛt hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/ de rnams kyi steng du ā las ka pā la'i nang du/ dbus su hūm̐ las sha chen dang rkang mar/ shar du oṃ las ba glang gi sha dang dri chen/ byang du hā las glang po che'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu hrīḥlas rta'i sha dang khu ba/ lhor ām̐ las khyi'i sha dang rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su oṃ yig de'i steng du āḥlas zla phyed/ hūm̐ las rdo rje/ oṃ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams zhu ste bdud rtsi dkar por gyur/ dri ma thams cad phyir lud āḥzhes brjod pas bdud rtsi dmar por gyur/ kha dog dang dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par byas/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi kha dog sna tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par spel zhing spros/ oṃ yig zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs te bdud rtsi la thim/

zla phyed rdo rje oṃ yig dang bcas pa yang zhu zhing thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥswā hā/ zhes tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ na mo thabs dang shes rab= dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs= na mo thabs dang= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma= na mo thabs dang= dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun lcam= mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang*// mos gus gzhom med pho brang du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin phob la// tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na ā we sha ya a a/ stug po'i zhing khams 'jig med pa// dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum sde'i dbus// rta yi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// phrag dog rdo rje don yod grub// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sogs// mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing*// dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod nas// rdo rje rgyal po bde skyed yum// dam tshig sgrol ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rnam 'phrul= /phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i gnas// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun nas// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bka' nyan pa'i// phyag brnyan pho nya 'byung po'i tshogs// rnam= /bdud tshogs kun 'dul phrin las zhing*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// bgegs bcom 'dod don kun sgrub pa// chos skyong bstan srung tshogs rnams kyang*/

rnam= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi thor tshugs ldems se ldem// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo// rol mo mang po ti ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne// gtad med rig pa sa la la// brjod med dbyings su tha la la// bde ba chen po phri li li// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// 'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres// gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a a/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun dang bral// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a la la hoḥ de nas tshogs phud bcad la/ zhal zas ro brgya dang*/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pheṃ badz+ra ā ra l+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ.oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs lan gsum dang*/ oṃ mchod do// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal zhing*// rtog pa kun las nges grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces tshogs phud phul zhing tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdus te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ a kā ro lan gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung la gnas pa'i 'byung po 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga lta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// khyed rnams rdo rje theg pa gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ de nas rdo rje'i glu dang*/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol smon lam sogs bya'o// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshogs mchod shin tu bsdus pa bsod nams sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi mchod pa shin tu bsdus pa bya bar 'dod pas/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu la sogs pa dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku bris 'bur ji ltar rigs pa'i mdun/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor pa bkod pas mdzes par bshams la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa nyer bsdu dang bcas pa grub nas/ tshogs rdzas rnams la nang mchod chu chang gis bran nas/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyid pu gsum la brten pa'i a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ tshogs kyi yo byad sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing spyan drang*/

pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun gyi rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par gyur pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces sman phud dbul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// zhal zas 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bzhes nas byin rlabs char chen dbab tu gsol// bcom ldan dpal chen 'khor lo sdom pa sogs// rab 'byams rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lhar// zhal zas= /bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rgyal kun yum gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// zhing sngags lhan skyes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar// zhal zas= /bzhes nas tshe 'dir mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzod// dpal mgon gur zhal dur khrod bdag po sogs// chos skyong srung ma nor lha rgya mtsho la// zhal zas= /bzhes nas rnam bzhi'i phrin las yid bzhin sgrubs// gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod gnas brgyad na// bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas la// zhal zas= /bzhes nas bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen spel/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa shrī badz+ra yo gi nī dharma pā la ḍā ka ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas tshogs phud 'bul/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par mos la/ a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod cing longs spyad pa'i lhag ma rnams bsdus te/

chang gi kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas 'thor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ lhag ma'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di// 'byung po lhag mar dbang ba'i tshogs la sbyin// zag med bde ba mchog gis lus dang sems// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal pa ldan gyur cig /ces phyi rol tu dor/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /dge ba 'di yis skye ba thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'bral ba med par rtag tu rjes bzung zhing*// mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes bkra shis dang smon lam bya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad skang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol/ rten la 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs/ rang gi gnas rnams su sogs go cha bkod/ bsrung ba bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod bcas byas la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhes pa 'di tsam dus dang rgyun du ma chags par nyams su blang bas kyang tshogs zur myur du 'dum zhing mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i lam gyi gtso bo yin pas shin tu gal che bas dpyod ldan rnams kyi lag len du 'debs tshal/ zhes rje bla ma rin po ches bka'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa ltar blo gter dbang pos spel ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
